objective: Finite whole-helper engineering envelope for the certified native Windows environment under declared ordinary load, retaining fail-closed behavior outside it. No hard-real-time, zero-timeout, mathematical maximum or worst-case scheduling claim.

priorFormulaReview.reason: The previous observed maximum is not an upper tolerance estimate U; one timeout is right-censored.1500ms and30% are unvalidated engineering policy choices, not measured platform bounds. They may be compared later but do not establish a numeric replacement.

selectionRule.scope: C1 first: only per-helper finite whole-lifecycle bound, subject to independent aggregate/CLI/security review.

candidateDomain.reason: The unchanged20s helper-active cap makes a larger per-helper allowance ineffective for a fresh first helper. Domain is an analysis ceiling, not authorization or a claim that20s is acceptable.

selectionRule.rawRequirement: R=U+V+Q, only when each term has an independent documented basis. U is a justified upper successful-lifecycle envelope; V is explicitly justified ordinary-load/startup variability not already in U; Q is bounded measurement uncertainty not already in U/V. Do not double-count.
selectionRule.rounding: After R exists, choose the smallest500ms grid value H>=R in (5000,20000], then assess DoS and aggregate/admission clipping. Never select H first.
evidenceGate: No unresolved successful-completion censoring may be converted into an upper observation.
No guessed observer-overhead subtraction or same-host sequential-campaign causal pairing.
U/V/Q require independent statistical or engineering justification; finite sample maxima/spreads alone are not sufficient.
Transfer to the earlier private sequence clock must include its framing, decoding and exit-checkpoint costs in the justified envelope; standalone supervisor times omit that transfer.
Explicit aggregate/CLI and security review must support the smallest scope before any numeric proposal.

resultBranches.BOUND_SELECTED: Only if U,V,Q are justified and the finite rounded candidate passes all coherence/security gates; proposal still requires separate correction authority.
resultBranches.MORE_CHARACTERIZATION_REQUIRED: If U,V,Q or observer sensitivity remain unresolved, or censoring prevents a successful upper envelope; retain5000 and specify finite missing evidence/authority.
resultBranches.MODEL_C_NOT_COHERENT: Only if evidence establishes no finite whole-helper-only or separately justified related-budget correction can satisfy the declared security/coherence constraints.

reliability.type: Engineering envelope; no achieved population probability claimed.

statisticalIllustration.assumptions: Continuous independent identically distributed observations sampled from one predeclared ordinary-load stratum; not established for these sequential host observations.
statisticalIllustration.derivation: P(sample maximum covers at least fraction p)=1-p^n. Zero-failure upper failure probability solves(1-q)^n=alpha.
statisticalIllustration.warning: These calculations demonstrate limitations; they are not a reliability claim about this product. No historical population pooling.

measurementPolicy.primary: Real supervisor helperUsedMs through confirmed quiescence for successful single-helper samples; terminalAt-origin for refusal. Whole origin-to-transport settlement retained separately for comparison.
measurementPolicy.uncertainty: Parent notification, validation and settlement differ. Record those differences; they do not bound all OS scheduling or unobserved bootstrap uncertainty. Unknown Q remains unknown.
measurementPolicy.observerSensitivity: Compare retained prior same-request C/E cohorts descriptively, including censoring. They are sequential under uncontrolled host activity, not randomized or paired. No overhead subtraction.
measurementPolicy.bootstrap: NOT_OBSERVABLE separately; startup remains inside the whole clock.
